summary: Bug fix VALIDATED — Cycle menstruel /cycle PRÉVISIONS card now correctly rolls forward when last recorded cycle is in the past. Tested via fresh maman account + API-seeded cycles, then verified UI rendering on mobile viewport (390x844). Primary scenario (cycle 2026-05-01, 28d, today=22/06/2026) displays correctly: Prochaines règles 26/06/2026, Ovulation prévue 12/06/2026, Fenêtre fertile 07 juin → 13 juin. No-regression scenario (future cycle 2026-07-01) still shows 29/07/2026 with positive 'dans 36 jour(s)' — no undesired rolling. Calendar 6 mois and Historique render correctly. Note: an Expo restart was required for the new bundle to be served (Metro was caching the old version).
test_report_links: /tmp/cycle_screen.png (before expo restart — bug still showing due to Metro cache)
action_items: OPTIONAL polish: daysBetween() uses Math.floor on (next - new Date())/86400000 which subtracts current time-of-day, so the display reads 'dans 3 jour(s)' instead of the naive 'dans 4 jour(s)' (today 22/06 17:15 UTC vs midnight 26/06). To match calendar-day expectation, normalize both dates to local midnight before diffing. Not blocking — the rolling logic itself is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: cycle.tsx L77-104: the rolling while-loop (k<24 guard) is correct and behaves as intended.
cycle.tsx L21 daysBetween uses raw Date.getTime() diff floored — this includes time-of-day; consider zeroing hours/min/sec for calendar-day arithmetic to match user expectation.

fertile.ovulation uses the rolled `next` (next - 14j), but fertile.start (line 79) is still the original `dernier.date_debut_regles`. The returned object exposes `start` (original) and `next` (rolled). This is intentional — start represents the historical entry, next represents the upcoming projection. OK.

Metro bundler can serve stale code after edits (especially with EXPO_USE_FAST_RESOLVER and METRO_CACHE_ROOT set). Main agent should `supervisorctl restart expo` after editing /app/frontend/app/cycle.tsx (and similar) when the change isn't reflected.

register endpoint requires accepte_cgu/accepte_politique_confidentialite/accepte_donnees_sante (not accept_cgu) — see /app/backend/server.py L531-536. Documentation drift between Python field names and the README sample.

context_for_next_testing_agent: If validating /cycle again: (1) create a fresh maman account with accepte_cgu/accepte_politique_confidentialite/accepte_donnees_sante=true, (2) POST /api/cycle with a past date_debut_regles, (3) inject token into localStorage.auth_token + auth_user, (4) navigate to /cycle and assert PRÉVISIONS shows future dates. After ANY edit to cycle.tsx, run `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` and wait ~12s before re-testing — Metro CI mode caches aggressively.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: cycle.tsx fertile block computed next = dernier.start + cycleLen once (no rolling), so when the last logged cycle was more than one cycle in the past, daysUntilPeriod went negative and Math.max(0, ...) displayed 'dans 0 jour(s)' with stale May dates. Fix applied (L85-90): while (next < today && k < 24) advance next by cycleLen until next >= today, derive ovulation = next-14 and fertile window = [ovu-5, ovu+1]. Validated: with last cycle 01/05/2026 28d and today 22/06/2026, the loop iterates twice (k=1→29/05, k=2→26/06≥today) producing the expected projections.
